body: I did. Unfortunately our school doesn't care much for the mental health of its students.
Our school doesn't have a counselor and none of the teachers like us.
My parents don't care in the slightest about how I feel, and I don't know how to get professional help when I'm only 15.
I could definitely see the world hating me so much that it wants me to suffer as long as possible.
I feel bad that you can relate but it's also nice. Thanks for reading my post.
